runners_data.name: Bravemans Bounce

runners_data.name: Tribal

runners_data.name: Portnahapple

runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in both Curragh maiden starts for Andy Oliver at 1m2f/1m4f on yielding/yielding to soft; gelded since and now makes hurdling debut for champion trainer; player.

runners_data.name: Messire Des Bordes

runners_data.name: Royal Alliance
runners_data.comment: No positive Flat form since joining this yard; goes hurdling now
runners_data.spotlight: AW winner for George Boughey in 2024; no positive Flat form since joining this yard; goes hurdling now.

runners_data.name: Al What
runners_data.comment: Second reserve, has been running in modest Flat handicaps, no sign winning potential

races.name: Mongey Communications Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ellis Brittle

runners_data.name: Backinbusiness
runners_data.note: Unproven reserve with poor point-to-point form, needs significant improvement to feature

runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; pulled up in first point-to-point but took a 6l third of 11 next time; much more needed.

runners_data.name: Bud Fox
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong bumper form but disappointing since, needs to recapture debut winning form

runners_data.name: Tyson Fury
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid recent hurdles form, 20-day break ideal and handles good ground well

runners_data.spotlight: Added fourth Flat win in a Dundalk claimer in March; creditable efforts in three starts over hurdles; distant runner-up at Tramore last time (2m, soft); not totally discounted.

runners_data.name: Minella Mate
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from long layoff, bumper winner with useful Flat form but fitness query

runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner in June 2023 added a Galway Flat maiden later that summer; lightly raced since but ran well on AW when runner-up on penultimate start; disappointed as favourite in sole hurdling start in 2023.

runners_data.name: Royad
runners_data.note: Unknown style after 306-day absence, previous hurdles form poor and needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: French AW winner was well beaten over hurdles on Irish debut in July; absent since
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of a French AW Flat race in 2024 before being purchaed for 41,000euros; well beaten in sole hurdles start in July (2m, good); 306-day layoff to overcome.

runners_data.name: Pure Logic

runners_data.spotlight: Consistent placed form in bumpers, and took second on hurdling debut at Ballinrobe last year (2m1f, good); a bit below that when last seen at Taunton in November; should run her race but likely to find a few too good.

runners_data.name: Magico

runners_data.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner for Marco Botti in Britain; purchased for 89,000gns in August; brings a Flat rating of 89 for his hurdling/stable debut; should be suited by this better ground and of obvious interest given trainer/rider combination.

runners_data.name: Jerry From Kerry
runners_data.note: Prominent racer struggling in winners' company, better over shorter distances but 66-day gap helps

runners_data.name: Whet The Appetite

runners_data.name: Approval

runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; progressive 3yo on Flat for William Haggas in 2024, winning twice over 1m2f on good to firm; hasn't reached those heights since, including in latest two starts for Owen Burrows; purchased for 16,000gns in October and goes hurdling now in new headgear.

runners_data.name: Ancient Myth
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner purchased cheaply after losing form, 230-day break and trainer switch major negatives

runners_data.spotlight: Bought for 10,000gns after losing his form in two starts following a breakthrough Flat win at Thirsk (1m4f, good to firm) in August for David O'Meara; others more likely.

runners_data.name: Calzaghi
runners_data.comment: Flat winner was placed in final three starts for Kevin Coleman; makes hurdles/stable bow
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; winner of a Navan Flat handicap in 2024 (1m2f, good to yielding); placed in final three starts for Kevin Coleman on differing ground types before being purchased for 29,000gns; brings a Flat rating of 78 to this hurdles/stable debut.

runners_data.name: Strong Contender
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with poor maiden hurdle form, hard to recommend on recent evidence
runners_data.comment: Has it all to do on basis of opening three maiden hurdle runs
runners_data.spotlight: Has it all to do on basis of opening three maiden hurdle runs.

runners_data.name: Screaming Eagle
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 358-day layoff, limited ability on Flat and hurdles form poor
runners_data.comment: Reserve; 73-rated Flat maiden hasn't made much impact in two m'den hurdles so far
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; 73-rated Flat maiden after eight starts; hasn't made much impact in two maiden hurdle starts so far.

runners_data.name: Individualism
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid Flat form on good ground, 222-day break but stable booking positive

runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; won twice on the Flat for Charlie Johnston on good ground; rated 83 in that sphere; signed off British career with a tailed off finish at Hamilton in September; makes hurdling/stable debut now in a first-time tongue tie.

runners_data.name: Goodmancon

runners_data.spotlight: Still winless after nine bumper starts and his hurdling debut last time when third (1.75l in front of Whet The Appetite); others preferred.

runners_data.name: Chou Chou
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with jumping concerns from previous start, 494-day absence makes him hard to trust

runners_data.name: Money Shuffler
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with tendency to fade, 309-day layoff and poor form makes him vulnerable
runners_data.comment: Reserve; yet to demonstrate winning potential in two bumpers and four Flat starts
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; yet to demonstrate winning potential in two bumpers and four Flat starts; goes hurdling now.

races.paceDynamic: Approval will take them along at a steady gallop without pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner field. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be manageable through the early stages, with prominent racers like Pure Logic, Jerry From Kerry, Minella Mate and Individualism tracking within striking distance. This should set up a sprint finish from the final hurdle, where horses with finishing kick will be crucial. The sustainable pace and tactical finish strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The manageable gallop will suit closers who can quicken, with Magico's Flat speed particularly potent in a sprint finish. Bud Fox and Tyson Fury also possess the tactical speed to strike late when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can slip the field turning in
scenarios.body: Pure Logic or Minella Mate could capitalise on their forward positions when the pace quickens, getting first run on the field. Their race-fitness and proven hurdles form gives them an edge over the newcomers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Approval stops or falls, leaving no genuine pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy tactical affair with no rhythm, suiting experienced hurdlers who can adapt. Goodmancon's recent hurdles experience could prove decisive in a slowly-run scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Approval gets an easy lead and kicks clear at the last
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to dictate completely and steal a march on rivals. Only applies if Approval shows significantly more ability than his Flat form suggests.

watchPoints.text: Approval must handle the hurdles on debut as the only pace-setter - any early mistake leaves the race without rhythm
Magico's hurdles bow for Mullins could be significant given his Flat ability and Townend's booking
Pure Logic's 163-day layoff needs monitoring given his previous consistency over hurdles
The three McNamara runners (Approval, Calzaghe, Individualism) suggest stable confidence but all face question marks
Bud Fox needs to bounce back from disappointing recent form but his early bumper win has worked out well

races.name: MD O'Shea's Tourist Attraction Mares Hurdle (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Dunsy Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent form progression, well-suited to this trip and distance after impressive Fairyhouse win

runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; built upon the promise of her debut run at Down Royal (2m4f, yielding) in December to win by 6l in a big field at Fairyhouse (2m, heavy) in February; was withdrawn based on unsuitable ground at Perth last month so these conditions a question; this is just her third start, so she could outrun her rating.

runners_data.name: Disco Dancer
runners_data.note: Needs to bounce back from disappointing recent efforts but has proven class at this level with multiple wins
runners_data.comment: Well beaten last time and needs to go beyond her best to win
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; bumper/dual winning hurdler; returned from almost a year off when well beaten on Flat in February; more promise in 10l fifth over hurdles at Navan (2m, soft); didn't build on that at Bellewstown last time.

runners_data.name: Break My Soul
runners_data.note: Front runner with Grade 1 experience whose pace-setting style perfectly suits this race setup and field composition
runners_data.comment: Winning hurdler had a positive campaign over fences last season; the top-rated of these
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winning hurdler for Nicky Henderson and took fourth in Grade 1 company behind Lossiemouth at Aintree in 2025 (2m4f, good to soft); made a winning chase debut for this yard, and ran a valiant race when third in the Grand Annual at Cheltenham (2m, good); pulled up at Fairyhouse when last seen off top weight; top-rated of these reverting to hurdles; new headgear.

runners_data.name: Sainte Lucie

runners_data.name: Royal Hollow
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer may struggle with the likely sustained pace but has winning form at this exact trip
runners_data.comment: Three-time winning hurdler has a small bit to find on ratings but by no means dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner has landed three hurdle races, the latest of which came at Gowran in October in a conditions event (2m1f, soft); proved her health when winning her chasing debut at Clonmel last month; a small bit to find on ratings but by no means dismissed.

runners_data.name: Redwood Queen
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who needs the pace to collapse to be effective from her typical rear position
runners_data.comment: Hasn't won since joining this yard and poor below best last twice; needs to bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't won since joining this yard last year after unseating with the race at her mercy in a Wexford claimer; decent efforts in opening two runs for this yard, but not at her best recently; needs to bounce back; cheekpieces go on.

runners_data.name: Tir Og
runners_data.note: Form has leveled off badly and carries a 7lb penalty which makes her task significantly harder here
runners_data.comment: Progressed well early last season but form has levelled off since; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Progressed really well in the early part of last season, rising 30lb in ratings; form has levelled off since and was beaten 24l at Fairyhouse last time; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Bynx
runners_data.note: Long absence of 191 days is a major concern despite previous course and distance winning form at Thurles

runners_data.name: Katherine
runners_data.note: Poor recent form and even longer layoff of 214 days makes her hard to fancy on these terms
runners_data.comment: Disappointing in most recent Flat/hurdle starts; has it all to do on these terms
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner has been disappointing in Flat/hurdle starts recently and has it all to do on these terms.

runners_data.name: Queenofthelodge

runners_data.spotlight: Progressive handicapper was gaining a third win of 2025 when landing a 2m4f Clonmel mares' handicap in October in first-time tongue tie (yielding); her two outings in December against better company were not her best; the break may have done her good, but a bit to find.

races.paceDynamic: Break My Soul is the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace from the start, likely uncontested through the early stages. With most of the field sitting prominent or held up (Royal Hollow, Redwood Queen, Bynx, Katherine), the pace will build gradually rather than being fierce early. Break My Soul's ability to dictate terms without pressure creates a tactical advantage for those who can travel kindly in behind and produce a sustained finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to the pace to strike when Break My Soul comes under pressure in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Break My Soul maintains her jumping fluency and the pace stays manageable through halfway
scenarios.body: Break My Soul's class edge from Grade 1 company shows as she kicks clear after the last, with the hold-up horses struggling to close the gap from too far back. Her proven stamina at this trip and beyond makes her tough to peg back when allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Striker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from the third-last hurdle and Break My Soul comes under sustained pressure
scenarios.body: Sainte Lucie or Dunsy Rock, sitting in the perfect stalking position, produce telling moves to collar the leader in the final furlong. Their fresher profiles and tactical positioning prove decisive against a tiring front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle section and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Royal Hollow or Redwood Queen unleash powerful finishing kicks from the rear, with their stamina and late pace proving superior to the prominent runners. The lack of early pace allows them to get into contention despite their hold-up style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Break My Soul makes a jumping error or loses her position early in the race
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace-setter, allowing an outsider like Queenolthelodge or Tir Og to benefit from the chaos. The tactical advantage shifts to horses whose jockeys can adapt quickly to the changed circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Break My Soul's jumping fluency in the early stages will determine if she can maintain her tactical advantage throughout
Sainte Lucie's position tracking the leader through the middle section as Townend will want her close enough to strike
Royal Hollow and Redwood Queen getting into contention turning for home despite their hold-up styles
Bynx showing any signs of fitness despite the 191-day layoff as she has course winning form when right
The pace through halfway as a slow tempo would dramatically change the complexion of the finish

runners_data.name: Paul's Dream

runners_data.name: Walhaan
runners_data.note: Only leader means uncontested pace but 10-year-old legs and poor recent form

runners_data.name: Playtime
runners_data.note: Young improver with scope but inexperienced in these tactical battles

runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who won comfortably over C&D (good) for Andrew Balding in September and came good for current stable in slow-ground maiden hurdle in March; wide draw a negative on Flat return, though.

races.paceDynamic: Walhaan is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from flag to finish without early pressure. Behind him sits a cluster of prominent runners - Becasse, Wholelotofbusiness, Impero, Paul's Dream, Cappa Hill, Fast Felix and Playtime - creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. With only Ragmans Corner holding up, this becomes a race about who can best position themselves in the prominent pack and avoid the inevitable squeeze. This pace setup strongly favours horses with tactical pace who can sit handy but avoid the scrum - those who can track the leader without getting embroiled in the mid-pack traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Walhaan Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Walhaan sets steady fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The veteran gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear before the prominent pack can organize, with those best positioned behind benefiting from the honest gallop. Tactical speed from handy positions proves decisive as the field spreads out late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If the seven prominent runners bunch up and interfere with each other 2-3 out
scenarios.body: Traffic problems eliminate several fancied runners as they check and stumble over each other in the straight. Clean passages and room to maneuver become more valuable than raw ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes stop-start with the prominent bunch going too slow
scenarios.body: Ragmans Corner gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick from the rear as the others tire from positional battles. The race becomes a sprint finish where stamina reserves matter most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Walhaan stops quickly and multiple prominent runners challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with no clear tactical advantage as tired horses battle up the hill. Class and recent form become the deciding factors in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: Watch for a pile-up at the second-last flight where Becasse, Wholelotofbusiness, Impero, Paul's Dream, Cappa Hill, Fast Felix and Playtime will converge
Monitor if Walhaan gets an easy lead early - his recent form suggests he may not sustain the gallop
Check Ragmans Corner's jumping rhythm after 173 days off - any mistake eliminates his hold-up chance
Observe claiming riders Thomas O'Connor and Carl Millar in traffic situations with Fast Felix and Impero
Watch for Playtime to get outpaced early given his inexperience in this grade

races.paceDynamic: Butch Cassidy will set a controlled pace from the front with no obvious early pressure from this field of hold-up horses. Da Capo Glory, Sandor Clegane, D Art D Art, Justabitofyours and The Rebel County all prefer to come from behind, creating a tactical race where the leader can dictate terms. With minimal early pace pressure, Butch Cassidy can conserve energy through the middle stages before the hold-up horses make their moves from the back of the home straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as the slow early gallop will make it difficult for hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Butch Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Butch Cassidy maintains his prominent position without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The De Bromhead runner can dictate a steady gallop and have enough left to resist late challenges from the hold-up brigade. His prominent style becomes a significant tactical advantage when all his main rivals need the race to develop into a stronger pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sandor Clegane Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong in the closing stages allowing hold-up horses to close
scenarios.body: Sandor Clegane's class advantage over this field becomes decisive as Sean O'Keeffe times his challenge perfectly. His recent Down Royal win shows he's in form and ready to capitalize on a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Da Capo Bounces Back
scenarios.trigger: If Da Capo Glory reproduces his Cheltenham Martin Pipe form and gets the strong pace he needs
scenarios.body: Michael Kenneally's mount has shown smart hurdles form and his unseat at Punchestown was unlucky rather than ability-related. A genuinely-run race would suit his hold-up style perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: D Art Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the recent Killarney winner's confidence boost translates to another improved performance
scenarios.body: Thomas Cooper's charge caught the eye winning last time and Ricky Doyle knows the track well. The step up in class is significant but his hold-up style could benefit from any pace collapse.

watchPoints.text: Butch Cassidy could steal this if allowed to dictate a soft pace from the front with no early pressure
Sandor Clegane needs the pace to develop strongly in the final half-mile to showcase his class advantage
Da Capo Glory requires a genuinely-run race to be effective from his hold-up position
D Art D Art represents value if his recent Killarney confidence boost carries over to this higher grade
The lack of natural pace-setters could create a tactical crawl that favors front-running tactics

races.paceDynamic: Miss Doyenne, Emily Love, La Note Verte and Affinity Rock will ensure a genuine gallop from the start over this extended 2m5f trip. The pace will be honest throughout with multiple front-runners committed to going forward, creating a searching test of stamina in the closing stages. This strong early pace and stamina-sapping finish strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, while the confirmed front-runners risk burning out in a speed duel. The race shape clearly benefits closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Benefit Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners engage in a genuine speed battle from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up perfectly for hold-up horses to produce telling late runs as the pace-setters weaken. Gaoth Chuil and Billie Frechette are best positioned to capitalize with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets an easy lead while rivals cancel each other out
scenarios.body: A lone leader could steal a march and prove hard to peg back if the pace becomes more manageable early. Miss Doyenne or La Note Verte have the class to make all if getting their own way up front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not suicidal allowing prominent runners to strike
scenarios.body: Horses just behind the leaders can time their challenges perfectly to sweep past tiring pace-setters. Stormalong's Listed hurdle form here gives her strong claims from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners surprisingly go steady early creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A tactical affair would favor horses with the most natural speed rather than stamina. The better flat performers would benefit most from this unlikely scenario unfolding.

watchPoints.text: Miss Doyenne and La Note Verte may set unsustainable fractions if both commit to the lead early
Emily Love returning from 203-day absence could need the run despite her proven ability fresh
Gaoth Chuil's finishing kick could be perfectly suited if the pace is genuinely strong throughout
Stormalong has shown disappointingly in recent chase starts despite her proven course credentials
Any front-runner who gets an uncontested lead could prove very difficult to peg back late

races.paceDynamic: O'Moore Park will take the field along from the front with little early pressure, setting a sustainable gallop over this stamina-testing trip. Happy Jacky and Caesar Rock may track prominently early, but neither will force the pace. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will develop into a staying test rather than a speed battle, with the finish likely to be tactical as horses bunch up turning for home. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for those who can quicken late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate and horses bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows hold-up horses to get into ideal positions and unleash their finishing kicks. Those with tactical speed benefit most from the compressed finish that develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If O'Moore Park's gallop stretches the field more than expected over the trip
scenarios.body: The sustained pace finds out the stamina of hold-up horses while prominent trackers get first run on the leaders. Those positioned handy throughout avoid traffic problems in a strung-out finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Maintains
scenarios.trigger: If O'Moore Park gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure means O'Moore Park saves energy for a decisive move, while others struggle to bridge the gap. Townend's tactical awareness proves crucial in timing the acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish over the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina lottery with little separation until very late. Horses who stay strongly but lack tactical speed get swamped by those with better finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: O'Moore Park's jumping under pressure - yet to win over fences and needs to handle the occasion
Shanbally Kid's jumping reliability after recent unseating at Punchestown
Happy Jacky's fitness levels after 253-day absence, particularly in the closing stages
The Short Go's race positioning early - needs to be handy enough given limited recent racing
Kamikaz Du Plessis improving through the ranks and could outrun his 149lbs burden
